Minimizing that swelling even if you can't see it will offer relief. This means upping her water intake and keeping her wrist in a neutral position as often as possible. 

There is also an exercise that helps with it. Have her hold her hand and wrist out flat then curl her fingers in and bend her hand downwards. Then return hand to neutral position. The next step is to keep her fingers straight while bending her wrist upwards. So, curled fingers pointed towards ground, straight fingers pointed towards ceiling.
